name: Alessia Bellini
bio:
Alessia's meticulous nature and passion for motorsport led her to specialize in paint application. Growing up near Monza, the roar of engines was the soundtrack to her childhood. After apprenticing at a small body shop, she honed her skills in automotive refinishing, quickly gaining a reputation for flawless finishes and vibrant color matching. Her dedication to precision and her drive to push the boundaries of automotive aesthetics have made her a sought-after talent.

At Mercedes-AMG, Alessia is known for her innovative approach to paint technology and her ability to troubleshoot any issue, from minor imperfections to complete redesigns. She's constantly experimenting with new techniques and materials to improve durability and visual appeal. While focused on her craft, she also understands the importance of teamwork, always willing to share her knowledge and mentor junior colleagues. Her commitment to excellence sets her apart, ensuring every car leaving her shop is a masterpiece of engineering and artistry.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back into a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Alessia is of average height with a focused gaze and hands that show the dedication to her craft.

quirks: Always keeps a small espresso maker in her workspace.
Refers to her paint sprayer as 'la bacchetta magica' (the magic wand).
Humming Italian opera while meticulously inspecting paint jobs.
